title: Uniformization of complete Kähler manifolds with positive bisectional curvature
main_claim: Every connected noncompact complex manifold carrying a complete Kähler metric with pointwise strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature is biholomorphic to C^n (Yau's uniformization conjecture). There are no extra hypotheses on curvature bounds or volume growth.

issues.location: sections/variation.tex, Lemma disc-deformation (lem:disc-deformation) and the limit order in Prop. disc-inequality
issues.description: The argument depends on several nested limits: the minimizing sequence, then the parameter radius, then eta, eps, delta and j. It also needs the error coefficient C_j(L) to be independent of eps, of the interior compact K'_{j,eps} and of the corona loss. I checked this bookkeeping structurally and found it consistent. I did not verify it line by line. The main risk is whether the Taylor remainder O(|z|^3) is uniform along the minimizing sequence when the constants depend on K'_{j,eps}. The paper does address this explicitly.
issues.evidence: The text separates 'realization/Taylor' constants, which may depend on K'_{j,eps}, from the mixed-energy derivative bound (var:actual-energy-derivative), which uses only boundary coefficients. Fejér frequency choice P_eps ~ sqrt(B_eps/eps) gives B_eps/P_eps->0 and eps P_eps->0 as claimed.

coverage:
I read all of the LaTeX: preliminaries, flow, discs, variation, ellipsoids, charts, dynamics and uniformization. Below, ✓ means I checked the step by hand.

- **Flow:** the identity L_K Q = tr_K(α − D Ric α + D ddφ) ✓. The largest-eigenvalue max principle, with J(v) = av + log(1+av) and a Young absorption constant of 4e^{−2aQ} ✓. Bounds for P_t, P and U ✓. The singular-weight Hessian bound ✓.
- **Heat correction H_{L,t}:** the split at b* gives L^{2−2/p} t^{2/p} ✓. The identity ddH = η − 𝓗η ✓, and the time inequality through P − U/t ≤ 0 ✓. The cutoff χ satisfies χ^{-1}ddχ ≤ A u^{-2} h ✓ and χ_t/χ ≤ C(1 + t^{β−1}) ✓.
- **Scalar comparison:** the minimal-solution Gronwall argument with shell error N^{2n−1−k} ✓, and the volume identity ∂_t[(e^w − 1)dV] = Δw dV ✓.
- **Discs:** the symplectic evolution p(ddN) = ∂_t N ✓. Wiener–Masani: E_θ + E_{−θ} identity and the seminorm constants M/(2m²) and 1/(2m³) ✓. The Gauss-area identity 4πD(U)² = 2∫ω ✓. Disc compactness: L^{3/2} bound on e^{−ψ}, Morrey estimate ✓.
- **Variation:** the second-variation test with the field V = αhE_f l ✓, the spectral-factor majorant ✓, backward-clock signs ✓, log-submean/Jensen factors ✓, and the Schur-cost lemma, including canonicity of the Schur form with respect to the vertical subspace ✓.
- **Ellipsoids:** the John contact resolution ✓, the rectangular Levi formula and single-column form ✓, the aggregate Schur inequality ✓, and the chain ∂_tλ ≥ tr K ≥ e^{−F0} tr(b^T ddλ) ✓. The resulting viscosity inequality for F0 matches the scalar comparison ✓.
- **Joint positivity and Harnack:** the curvature blocks on M×C_w are exactly Cao's matrix Harnack, and I recomputed them (Θ_{ww̄} = tA + t²(A_t + A h^{-1} A)) ✓. Scalar Harnack integration, R(o,t) ≤ C, and the completeness argument via exit length ✓.
- **Charts:** the static-distortion L² extension bound (1+A)^{2k} ✓. In the Harnack-equality computation I recomputed (∂−Δ)S = −tr(A(A+k)²) and (∂−Δ)Z = Σ λ_j^{-1}|R_{jl}|² ✓. Gradient-flow loop contraction ✓, psh Liouville via convexity in log r ✓, common exponent ✓, and the three-circle small-ball estimate ✓.
- **Dynamics:** Ricci windows and the iteration contradiction ✓, rate order from bounded subharmonic functions on a strip ✓, weight propagation with loss at most nε0θ ✓, forbidden gap (0.9m − 1)θ ✓, contraction of the backward homological operator ✓, and the bad-component degree reset D_*^L Q_u ≤ (b0/2) Q_{v−N} ✓.
- **Uniformization:** orbit defect e^{−10 s_k} ✓, backward error sum ≤ e^{−6 s_k} ✓, injectivity and nonsingularity ✓, the inverse-ball fixed point ✓, and Bernstein–Walsh surjectivity ✓.
- **Lighter checks only:** the linear-alignment lemma's graph-extension details, the Krull closure step in extra integrability, and the parabolic regularity citations (LSU, Chu).
sibling_notes: The family 338 board already had an entry for this exact dir, saying rank212 no_gap_found and listing similar checks. I re-audited independently and reached the same conclusion, then overwrote that entry with my summary. No other companion-paper dependencies were found. The paper is self-contained apart from standard cited theorems (Hörmander/Demailly L², Li–Yau, Souplet–Zhang, Lee–Tam short-time existence, Chu regularity, CIL).
